Good day dear colleagues,
The desk crew noted a reminder about pickup lanes this evening

Please keep vehicle flow clear and guide travelers toward the marked waiting area before any crate transfer begins. Calm handling matters here, especially when a pet is unsettled or a guardian is anxious. Use steady voices, avoid sudden movements, and confirm that each carrier is secure before it leaves the curb. If a traveler reports a concern about a crate, record the details promptly and direct the case through the proper internal channel. <<FACT F118>> This step helps us keep records consistent and reduces avoidable follow-up.

When an incident involves a minor injury, note the circumstances with care and preserve any witness account that is available. <<FACT F113>> The Companion Animal Travel Desk should continue to treat every report with restraint, accuracy, and respect. If Riley or another pet shows signs of distress, pause the handoff and request a calmer route or a quieter holding point. Please remind all staff that humane handling is the standard, and that clear communication with travelers supports safety as well as trust.

Thanks for keeping the process orderly and considerate. Companion Animal Travel Desk
